method.time: GT file load + prediction file load + evaluate + accumulate + summarize; JSON included; inference and output serialization excluded
method.memory: Whole-process peak RSS, including input snapshots and output serialization
method.repeats: Three fresh processes per version and workload, alternating version order; medians and every sample retained
method.cache: No filesystem cache eviction; warm-cache measurements on a shared host
method.comparison_batches: Version comparisons, in-memory regression checks and other-backend comparisons ran in separate batches on the same CPU affinity; timing is subject to shared-host contention

yolo26n_file_agreement.verification: All samples match their backend reference array hashes in yolo26n_v012.json
